reason: I suddenly became short of breath with a dry cough this morning.
diagnosis: Most likely a brief postictal respiratory event after an unwitnessed seizure with missed levetiracetam, causing sudden dyspnea and dry cough without infectious or cardiac features.
keyPoints: Onset and duration of shortness of breath and cough
Relationship to the seizure last night and any postictal symptoms
Seizure history, usual control, and whether medication was missed
Associated red flags: chest pain, syncope, wheeze, cyanosis, aspiration, fever
Infectious symptoms and COVID exposure/travel history
Medication list, allergies, alcohol/substance use, and adherence triggers
Family history of epilepsy and baseline functional status
manner: worried but calm, gives clear answers, slightly forgetful
